name: Bearded Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Beard and Glaive attacks.

actions.name: Beard
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't already affected by the devil's Beard, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the devil's next turn.

description: Bearded devils are savage infantry demons of Hell's armies, their infected, quill-like beards spreading poison and staving off healing wherever they strike with their glaives.
